class="cs87334918"><span class="cs299D5A6E">VALIDITY FROM: 18/01/2022 TO 17/01/2027</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs63AB7302"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span><span class="csA533CB47">USG OF WHOLE ABDOMEN</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs299D5A6E">FINDINGS:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">LIVER:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Mild enlarged in Size (15 cm). Otherwise shape &amp; outline appears within normal limits. Parenchymal echotexture is homogeneous.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Intrahepatic biliary radicles are not dilated. No sizable focal lesion is noted.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">PORTAL VEIN:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Is normal (9.7 mm). </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">GALL BLADDER:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Gall bladder is partially distended. Gall bladder neck is not well visualised. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Visualised part of lumen appears clear. Wall thickness is normal. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">EXTRA HEPATIC BILE DUCT:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Is normal (5.7 mm). No calculus is detected within the visualised part of lumen.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">PANCREAS:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Size &amp; shape is normal. Echotexture appears normal. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Pancreatic duct is not dilated. No sizable focal lesion is seen.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">SPLEEN:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Size (8.2 cm) &amp; shape is normal. Echotexture is homogeneous. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">No sizable focal lesion is seen.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">KIDNEYS:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Right kidney - 10.2 cm. Left kidney - 10.8 cm.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Normal size. Cortical echotexture is normal.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Corticomedullary differentiation is maintained. Central echocomplexes are normal.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">No evidence of any SOL/ calculus / hydronephrosis is noted in either kidney.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">URINARY BLADDER:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Shape and contour is within normal limits. Bladder wall thickness appear normal.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">No intravesical mass / calculus is demonstrated.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Post void residue - 134 cc (Significant). </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">UTERUS:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Anteverted. Bulky in size (90 mm x 69 mm x 52 mm) &amp; globular in shape.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Myometrial echotexture is heterogenous with &nbsp;indistinct endometrium-myometrium junction. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Focal calcified area (14 x 9 mm) seen in anterior myometrium of uterus. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Fibroid measuring 40 x 37 mm is seen at posterior myometrium of uterus. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Endometrial thickness is 7.9 mm. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs3BC46F97">OVARIES:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Right ovary measures- 35 mm x 26 mm.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Left ovary measures- &nbsp;28 mm x 21 mm. </span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Ovaries appear normal in size, shape &amp; echotexture. Right ovary appears adherent to uterus.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="cs299D5A6E">IMPRESSION:</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">- Mild hepatomegaly.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">- Bulky &amp; globular uterus with features of adenomyosis.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">- Focal calcified area in anterior myometrium of uterus.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">- Fibroid in posterior myometrium of uterus.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">- Significant post void residual urine.</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">Please correlate clinically.</span></p><table class="csFBC86493" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse;">			<tr style="height:108pt;">				<td class="csB498827F" valign="top"><p class="cs87334918"><a name="FENIX_SIGNATURE_ROW_FNL_1_1789629618915"><span class="csD1E5A74A"><img src="data:image/png;base64," width="58" height="63" alt="" style="border-width:0px;" /><br/></span><span class="cs658C6777">Dr. Tuli Roy<br/>Attending Consultant Radiodiagnosis<br/>MBBS, DNB (Radiodiagnosis)</span></a></p></td><td class="csB498827F" valign="top"><p class="cs539A2146"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p></td></tr>		</table>		<p class="cs87334918"><span class="csD1E5A74A">&nbsp;</span></p></body></html>||||||F|||20260917125114||tuliroy^Dr. Tuli Roy|||||||||||||
